channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: EU proposes sanctions on Russian banks and crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal would bar transactions with about 60 banks, target crypto networks and restrict Russian teams at EU sports events.

item.title: EU proposes crypto sanctions in 22nd Russia package
item.description: The Commission proposed sanctions on 60 Russian banks and crypto networks, but all 27 EU states must approve the package before the measures take effect.

item.title: How to use SyncSwap safely with a wallet you control
item.description: How to use SyncSwap safely with your wallet: verify the URL, limit approvals, inspect signatures and know what to do if a wallet is compromised.

item.title: Aave V3 reserve data is a packed risk map
item.description: How to decode Aave V3 reserve configuration data: shift and mask each field, then read basis points, whole-token caps and flags in their proper units.

item.title: Which habits save the most money on regular DEX swaps: five cost cuts
item.description: Which habits save the most money on regular DEX swaps? Compare net output, match pools, use an L2, split selectively and tune slippage to cut routine costs.

item.title: US seeks forfeiture of $1.1bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: The Justice Department has filed to forfeit more than $1.1 billion in frozen USDC tied to the Binance hack, starting a court process to recover the funds.

item.title: What Is the TREAT Token? Shiba Inu’s Rewards Role
item.description: What is the TREAT token in the Shiba Inu ecosystem? TREAT is its rewards token. Learn how it differs from SHIB, LEASH and BONE, and verify its contract before swapping.

item.title: EU proposes crypto network sanctions in 22nd Russia package
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions proposal targets crypto and payment networks, including in third countries, as it seeks to curb sanctions evasion.

item.title: Ethereum Beacon Chain: How Its Validator Proofs Enable Restaking
item.description: What is the Beacon Chain in Ethereum? It runs proof of stake, tracks validators and stakes, and supplies the balance proofs native restaking needs.

item.title: Do DEXs Require KYC When You Swap From Your Own Wallet?
item.description: Do decentralized exchanges require KYC? Usually no: a wallet-signed swap needs no account, while fiat on-ramps and centralized exchanges may ask for ID.

item.title: Injective Voters Approve Veyra Upgrade for Nov. 24 Target
item.description: Injective’s Veyra proposal cleared governance with 42.69% turnout, setting a block-height halt for v1.21.0 and adding cross-chain and RFQ tools.

item.title: What is wrapped ether used for in token swaps: Why DEXs use WETH
item.description: What is wrapped ether used for in token swaps? WETH lets swap contracts handle ETH as an ERC-20; wrapping and unwrapping take gas, with no exchange fee.

item.title: MoonPay seeks OCC charter for trust bank and stablecoin services
item.description: MoonPay has asked the OCC to charter a trust bank for custody, stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management, and agent conversion services.

item.title: BLS Signature Aggregation in an AVS, Step by Step
item.description: BLS signature aggregation in an AVS combines Operators’ signatures on one message into one proof, which a contract checks against quorum stake to confirm it.

item.title: Chainflip says attacker stole 122.86 BTC in $12m vault raid
item.description: Chainflip says an attacker stole 122.86 BTC alongside ETH and stablecoins, lifting losses to about $12 million as the protocol offers a 10% return bounty.

item.title: US wins court authority over $1.2bn in stolen Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department says a court authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2bn in crypto stolen from Binance as tracing and forfeiture efforts continue.

item.title: How to connect MetaMask to ShibaSwap and check your network
item.description: To connect MetaMask to shiba swap, open the trusted interface, choose MetaMask, approve the intended account, then confirm the active network before using the app.

item.title: How to Set Up MetaMask and Get Your First Address
item.description: How to set up a MetaMask wallet step by step: install the official extension, create and back up your wallet, then copy your first receiving address.

item.title: Polygon PoS State Sync: How Deposits Get Minted
item.description: Why bridged tokens arrive on Polygon without paying gas: Heimdall validators relay the Ethereum event, then Bor mints your deposit by system call.

item.title: DBS and Circle open 24/7 USDC access to institutions in Asia
item.description: DBS will let eligible institutions mint and redeem Circle’s USDC around the clock, creating a bank route into stablecoin settlement across Asia.
